vehicleDetails.title: 450 X
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather 450X stands as a flagship model in Ather Energy’s lineup, renowned for its sporty performance, agile handling, and advanced smart features. It is available in two main battery configurations, each offering distinct range capabilities to suit different commuting needs.

Ather 450X Lineup Overview

Detailed Breakdown

  • Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): This variant serves as the high-performance entry point, ideal for riders who primarily navigate dense city traffic and want the punchy, sporty ride that Ather is known for. It offers a nimble experience without the extra weight of the larger battery pack.
  • Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): Designed for riders who need maximum endurance, this flagship battery option significantly reduces the frequency of charging. It is the preferred choice for those who tackle longer inter-city commutes or want the peace of mind that comes with a higher range.

Why Choose the Ather 450X?

The Ather 450X is built for riders who value a premium, "geeky," and high-performance electric experience.

  • Advanced Cockpit: Unlike the more pragmatic 450S, the 450X features a full-color 7-inch TFT touchscreen display that provides a rich, interactive interface.
  • Performance & Tech: With its 6.4 kW motor, it delivers thrilling, instant torque, making it one of the quickest scooters in its segment. When equipped with the optional Pro Pack, users unlock advanced features like integrated Google Maps, AutoHold™, Warp Mode, and comprehensive ride statistics.
  • Safety & Reliability: The 450X is equipped with robust safety hardware, including disc brakes on both ends, multi-mode Traction Control, and FallSafe™ (which cuts motor power in the event of a tip-over). It remains a top choice for those who want a blend of aggressive performance and sophisticated modern technology.

variantData.metaTitle: Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): Price, Range, Images, Features | EVINDIA
variantData.description:
The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) is the quintessential smart electric scooter, designed for riders who demand thrilling acceleration and a premium digital experience without needing the absolute largest battery pack. It combines Ather’s legendary, precision-machined hybrid chassis with a high-output motor and a stunning interactive touchscreen. It is the perfect choice for the modern urban commuter who wants sports-car-like zip, razor-sharp handling, and smartphone-level connectivity for their daily city runs.

Key Performance & Specifications

  • Aggressive Powertrain: The hallmark of the 450X series is its upgraded performance. Powered by a highly potent 6.4 kW PMSM motor delivering 26 Nm of peak torque, it rockets from 0–40 km/h in a blistering 3.3 seconds, making it significantly quicker off the line than the "S" series.
  • City-Optimized Range: Equipped with a dependable 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, this variant offers an IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 111 km. This provides a comfortable real-world TrueRange™ perfectly suited for daily office commutes, college runs, and localized errands.
  • TFT Touchscreen Interface: The cockpit is dominated by a brilliant, full-color 7-inch TFT Touchscreen. With an IP65 durability rating, it brings the scooter to life with an intuitive Android-based operating system, providing a premium visual experience.
  • Warp Mode Enabled: Unlike the "S" variants, the 450X grants you access to Ather's legendary Warp Mode—a hyper-aggressive throttle mapping that unleashes the motor's full 6.4 kW peak power for maximum thrills.
  • Premium Underpinnings: It features 12-inch alloy wheels, symmetrically mounted progressive monoshock suspension, and front/rear disc brakes connected via a highly responsive Combined Braking System (CBS).

Why Ather 450X (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) occupies a highly strategic position in the lineup. Here is how it compares to its siblings to help you make the right choice.

1. Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450S (2.9 kWh): Performance & Tech Upgrade

This is the choice between straightforward utility and premium performance.

  • Shared Endurance: Both models utilize the exact same 2.9 kWh battery size, offering highly similar city-focused ranges (122 km IDC for the S, 111 km IDC for the X due to the X's higher power draw).
  • Power & Speed: The Ather 450S (2.9 kWh) uses a 5.4 kW motor. The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) upgrades to a much punchier 6.4 kW motor, dropping the 0-40 km/h acceleration time from 3.9 seconds down to a blistering 3.3 seconds.
  • The Dashboard: The 450S uses the physical DeepView™ LCD. The 450X gives you the full, vibrant TFT Touchscreen.
  • Verdict: Choose the 450S for a simpler, slightly longer-lasting city commute. Upgrade to the Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) if you want thrilling "Warp Mode" acceleration and a premium touchscreen interface.

2. Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): The Range Extension

If you know you want the touchscreen and the high-output motor, your decision comes down to battery size.

  • Identical Experience: Both scooters feature the exact same 6.4 kW motor, 7-inch TFT touchscreen, Warp Mode, and aggressive styling.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) delivers a 111 km IDC range. The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery pack to push that range up to a massive 150 km IDC, significantly extending your time between charges.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is short and predictable, the Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) is perfectly sized. If you travel inter-city, hate charging frequently, or want maximum peace of mind, the 3.7 kWh variant is the necessary upgrade.

3. Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) VS Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh): The Software Unlock

This comparison determines whether you want the basic touchscreen or the fully unlocked smart experience.

  • Hardware Parity: Both models are physically identical, sharing the 2.9 kWh battery, 6.4 kW motor, and the physical TFT screen.
  • The Pro Pack Difference: The standard Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) gives you the touchscreen but limits software features. Upgrading to the Ather 450X Pro (2.9 kWh) unlocks the screen's full potential—adding integrated Google Maps, Bluetooth music/call controls, AutoHold™, and detailed ride statistics via the Ather App.
  • Verdict: Choose the standard 450X if you just want the physical acceleration of Warp mode. If you want your dashboard to act like a smart device with built-in navigation and connectivity, you must opt for the Pro variant.

Why Choose the Ather 450X (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) is the perfect machine for the adrenaline-seeking city rider. It gives you all the physical prestige of Ather's flagship model—the massive 6.4 kW motor, the brilliant TFT Touchscreen, and the thrilling Warp Mode—packaged with a battery that perfectly matches the rhythm of daily urban life. It is the ultimate combination of speed, style, and smart electric engineering.

variantData.description:
The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) is engineered for the uncompromising urban rider. It combines Ather’s most powerful electric motor with its largest available battery pack and a stunning interactive touchscreen. If you demand sports-car-like acceleration, razor-sharp handling, and the ability to travel long distances without constantly worrying about your next charge, this is the foundational flagship you have been looking for. It delivers the premium Ather hardware experience scaled for maximum endurance.

Key Performance & Specifications

  • Maximum Endurance: The standout feature is the massive 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery. It pushes the scooter to an impressive IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 150-161 km, ensuring you can tackle long inter-city commutes or multiple days of city riding on a single charge.
  • Aggressive Powertrain: It is powered by a highly potent 6.4 kW PMSM motor delivering 26 Nm of peak torque. This setup provides thrilling acceleration, rocketing from 0–40 km/h in a blistering 3.3 seconds with a top speed of 90 km/h.
  • TFT Touchscreen Interface: The cockpit features a brilliant, full-color 7-inch TFT Touchscreen. Operating on an Android-based OS, it offers a visually premium, smartphone-like interface that easily outclasses standard digital displays.
  • Precision Handling: Built on Ather's legendary precision-machined hybrid chassis, it features 12-inch alloy wheels, symmetrically mounted progressive monoshock suspension, and highly responsive front and rear disc brakes.

Variant Comparison: Where Does This 450X Fit?

The Ather lineup is highly modular. Here is how the Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) compares to its closest siblings to help you determine exactly which features you need.

1. Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): The Range Extension

If you know you want the touchscreen and the powerful 6.4 kW motor, your decision comes down entirely to battery size.

  • Identical Experience: Both scooters feature the exact same aggressive motor, 3.3-second acceleration, and vibrant 7-inch TFT touchscreen.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather 450X (2.9 kWh) uses a smaller battery that delivers a 111 km IDC range. The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery pack to extend that range up to a massive 150+ km IDC.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is short and highly predictable, the 2.9 kWh variant is perfectly sized. If you travel inter-city, hate charging frequently, or want maximum peace of mind, the Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450S (3.7 kWh): The Technology Upgrade

This comparison is for riders who want the large battery but are debating the dashboard and motor power.

  • Shared Endurance: Both models utilize the large 3.7 kWh battery, offering the same excellent long-distance commuting capability.
  • Power & Interface: The Ather 450S (3.7 kWh) uses a slightly less powerful 5.4 kW motor and features a physical DeepView™ LCD display. The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) upgrades you to the punchy 6.4 kW motor (making it significantly faster off the line) and replaces the LCD with a full TFT Touchscreen.
  • Verdict: Choose the 450S if you want maximum range on a budget with a simpler physical display. Upgrade to the Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) if you want thrilling acceleration and a premium, interactive cockpit.

3. Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) VS Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh): The Software Unlock

This is the final step up. It determines whether you want the basic touchscreen or the fully unlocked smart experience.

  • Hardware Parity: Both models are physically identical, sharing the massive 3.7 kWh battery, the 6.4 kW motor, and the physical TFT screen.
  • The Pro Pack Difference: The standard Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) gives you the touchscreen hardware but limits software features. Upgrading to the Ather 450X Pro (3.7 kWh) unlocks the screen's full potential—giving you integrated Google Maps, Bluetooth music/call controls, AutoHold™, the legendary Warp Mode, and detailed ride statistics.
  • Verdict: Choose the standard model if you simply want the physical performance and range. If you want your dashboard to act like a fully connected smart device with built-in navigation and maximum acceleration modes, you must opt for the Pro variant.

Why Choose the Ather 450X (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather 450X (3.7 kWh) is the perfect foundation for the demanding rider. It secures the most important, un-upgradable hardware Ather offers: the largest battery and the most powerful motor. It guarantees you will never be left wanting for physical speed or driving distance, all while enjoying the sleek aesthetics of the TFT touchscreen interface.
